sources.document_title: Board Split Decision - Fix List + A/B Interface Contract
sources.locator: Decision set (b) Board A <-> Board B interface contract: Connector, Pinout, Current-rating math and Keying/foolproofing sections
sources.evidence_extract: LOCKED: Board-side part (both boards) JST B6B-XH-A(LF)(SN), C144397, 6-pin top-entry shrouded through-hole header, 2.5 mm pitch, rated 3 A per contact with AWG #22 250 V. Pinout table: 1=+15V (A->B, Board A VBUS_OUT post Q1 load switch), 2=+15V (paired with pin 1, current sharing), 3=ATT (A->B open-drain active-low, STUSB4500 pin 11/ATTACH, no on-board pull-up), 4=PDOK (A->B open-drain active-low, STUSB4500 pin 20/POWER_OK2, asserts on a live PDO2 15V contract, same pull-up rule as ATT), 5=GND (paired return), 6=GND (paired return). Current-rating math: worst case is the PD contract cap of 3.0 A at 15 V; 2 contacts at 80% continuous derating = 4.8 A derated capacity (6.0 A nameplate) versus the 3.0 A worst-case load = 1.6x derated margin (2.0x nameplate); GND uses the identical 2-contact math. Keying: XH shrouded housing is mechanically polarized (reversed insertion blocked); the 6-pin XH is the only 6-position XH on either board so the cable cannot land on a wrong header; pin 1 is silkscreen-marked on both boards.
